ambiguities.reason: The senior discount is stated but Jimmy and Irene are not explicitly identified as senior citizens.
How long has the tree grown could literally mean duration; intended height increment is inferable but not explicitly named.
A month is not defined to be four weeks; the standard benchmark convention is an assumption, not supplied data.
Half that amount most naturally refers to the grandmother's 30 dolls but could be read as half the combined collection.
Recoveries reduce currently positive cases but not cumulative positive-case counts; the phrase total positive cases alone is ambiguous.

Midterm timing is not numerically specified. The conventional halfway interpretation gives six elapsed weeks, four active weeks, and 52 hours. Full-semester subtraction gives 130 but does not answer that interpretation.
